limitations: Synthetic local pixel fixtures plus actual Deck Point/GeoJSON consumption/materialization and MapLibre tests; the complete mounted Kepler acceptance matrix is a separate compiled gate.
Actual raw WebGL and actual MapLibre style-diff cases ran in Chromium and WebKit.
Pixel 7 and iPhone 13 are desktop engine emulations, not real devices or device-GPU benchmarks.
Firefox launch attempted after dependency restore but timed out with RenderCompositorSWGL framebuffer failure; no Firefox capture results.
WebKit does not expose the longtask observer; its empty list is not proof of zero long tasks.
No production, authenticated, remote tile/font/network, or physical GPU matrix was exercised.
No hardware SLO achievement is claimed. Baseline comparison is only for a pixel-equivalent simple synthetic scene and the exact historical source commit.
sourceDescription: Frozen consumed-clustering correction: immutable Point/GeoJSON policy and native-source receipts, synchronous materialization, drawn-frame identity, mandatory saved extension, positive saved-empty dataset proof, and existing capture fidelity guards

mountedFollowUp.note: Mounted run preceded final missing-envelope and high-zoom tightening; combined final build gate owns the frozen-state rerun.

framingCharacterization.policy: Nonuniform legacy X/Y normalization to960x540; zero RGBA differences compare after normalization, not geometry across aspect ratios

measurementRunPurpose: 16-case evidence-only rerun (8 real-Deck provenance cases and 8 measured timing/baseline cases), immediately after the separate complete 104/104 matrix

postMeasurementCommentOnlyChange.change: Remove newly added lint suppression; preserve the existing @ts-nocheck warning
